```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(readxl); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(purrr); library(stringr)
```

# Purpose

The manuscript's counts and the Spanish recount (`RESULTADOS YOLANDA. TFG Agusti.docx`)
disagree. This script rebuilds every published number from the raw Excel so the three can be
compared. **No inferential statistics are run here and none may be run until this closes.**

Where a definition in the paper is ambiguous, every plausible reading is computed rather than
one being chosen -- the disagreements are far more likely to be definitional than arithmetic.

# Load

```{r load}
raw_dir <- file.path("..", "..", "data", "raw")
xl <- list.files(raw_dir, pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(xl) == 1)

# Row 1 of the sheet is a merged group header; row 2 carries the column names.
d <- read_excel(xl, sheet = "Datos", skip = 1)
names(d)[1] <- "row_index"
names(d)[2] <- "pid"
names(d)[3] <- "sex"
names(d)[4] <- "age"

cat("participants:", nrow(d), " columns:", ncol(d), "\n")
cat("sex 1=male, 2=female:", paste(names(table(d$sex)), table(d$sex), sep = "="), "\n")
cat("age: mean", round(mean(d$age), 1), "SD", round(sd(d$age), 1),
    "range", min(d$age), "-", max(d$age), "\n")

grid_cols <- names(d)[5:ncol(d)]
stopifnot(length(grid_cols) == 23 * 12)
stopifnot(all(unlist(d[grid_cols]) %in% c(0, 1)))
cat("outcome grid:", length(grid_cols), "binary columns, no missing values\n")
```

## Long form: one row per participant x stimulus x drawing

```{r long}
long <- d |>
  select(pid, sex, age, all_of(grid_cols)) |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(grid_cols), names_to = "cell", values_to = "vs") |>
  mutate(
    im  = as.integer(str_match(cell, "^IM(\\d+) ")[, 2]),
    e   = as.integer(str_match(cell, " E(\\d+)$")[, 2]),
    with_sound = e >= 1 & e <= 12,
    stim = case_when(
      e == 1 ~ "sound_only",
      e %in% 2:4   ~ "COS", e %in% 13:15 ~ "COS",
      e %in% 5:12  ~ "DS",  e %in% 16:23 ~ "DS"
    ),
    # the same oral stimulus, with and without sound, shares a label
    oral = case_when(
      e %in% c(2, 13) ~ "M1", e %in% c(3, 14) ~ "M2", e %in% c(4, 15) ~ "M3",
      e %in% c(5, 16) ~ "11V", e %in% c(6, 17) ~ "21V",
      e %in% c(7, 18) ~ "31V", e %in% c(8, 19) ~ "41V",
      e %in% c(9, 20) ~ "11P", e %in% c(10, 21) ~ "21P",
      e %in% c(11, 22) ~ "31L", e %in% c(12, 23) ~ "41L",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

stopifnot(nrow(long) == 38 * 23 * 12)

# per participant x stimulus: was there a VS anywhere, and in which drawings
by_stim <- long |>
  group_by(pid, e, stim, oral, with_sound) |>
  summarise(any_vs = as.integer(any(vs == 1)),
            n_im   = sum(vs),
            set_im = paste(sort(im[vs == 1]), collapse = ","),
            .groups = "drop")

cat("stimulus-level rows:", nrow(by_stim), "\n")
```

# 1. Prevalence

```{r prevalence}
p <- by_stim |>
  group_by(pid) |>
  summarise(
    vs_sound       = any(e == 1 & any_vs == 1),
    vs_ops_alone   = any(e %in% 13:23 & any_vs == 1),   # phase 4: OPS, no sound
    vs_ops_wsound  = any(e %in% 2:12  & any_vs == 1),   # phase 3: OPS + sound
    vs_ops_either  = vs_ops_alone | vs_ops_wsound,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

prev <- function(ops) {
  tibble(
    sound_only  = sum(p$vs_sound & !ops),
    ops_only    = sum(!p$vs_sound & ops),
    both        = sum(p$vs_sound & ops),
    neither     = sum(!p$vs_sound & !ops),
    any_vs      = sum(p$vs_sound | ops),
    n_sound     = sum(p$vs_sound),
    n_ops       = sum(ops)
  )
}

cat("--- OPS read as phase 4 only (E13-E23) ---\n"); print(prev(p$vs_ops_alone))
cat("--- OPS read as any oral stimulus (E2-E23) ---\n"); print(prev(p$vs_ops_either))
```

# 2. Elimination of sound-induced VS

The paper's headline: of those with VS under sound alone, how many had it *eliminated* by an
oral stimulus applied while the sound continued? "Elimination" in the recount is
*recuperan la linea entera* -- the whole line returns, i.e. **no VS in any of the 12
drawings** for that stimulus.

```{r elimination}
resp <- p |> filter(vs_sound) |> pull(pid)
cat("participants with sound-induced VS:", length(resp), "\n")

elim <- by_stim |>
  filter(pid %in% resp, e %in% 2:12) |>          # phase 3: OPS *with* sound maintained
  group_by(pid) |>
  summarise(
    by_COS = any(stim == "COS" & any_vs == 0),
    by_DS  = any(stim == "DS"  & any_vs == 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(any_elim = by_COS | by_DS)

cat("eliminated by any OPS:", sum(elim$any_elim), "of", nrow(elim), "\n")
cat("  DS only :", sum(elim$by_DS & !elim$by_COS), "\n")
cat("  COS only:", sum(elim$by_COS & !elim$by_DS), "\n")
cat("  both    :", sum(elim$by_DS & elim$by_COS), "\n")
```

# 3. Spatial concordance (sound vs oral stimuli)

⚠️ **Added 2026-08-17 — the "manuscript" figures in this section and the next could not be
verified against the draft on disk, and the numbers below are left unchanged pending Sophie.**

The draft (`Manuscript/drafts/…-EGH.docx`) was read in full on 2026-08-17. It contains
**exactly one** concordance analysis — the anatomical COS↔DS one, in Results ¶178, reported as
**5 complete / 3 partial / 3 none**. Two consequences:

1. This section's "paper reports 12 exact / 5 partial / 3 none" **is not in the draft.** No
   same-drawings concordance analysis appears in it at all. Either it was in the submitted
   version (which is not on disk — see `Manuscript/MANUSCRIPT.md`), or it was mis-attributed
   here.
2. Section 4's "manuscript 4 / 5 / 3" for COS–DS **contradicts the draft's 5 / 3 / 3.** The
   Spanish recount also says 5/3/3, and Reviewer 1's letter quotes 5/3/3. So three independent
   sources agree, and the 4/5/3 recorded here looks like a transcription error.

The hardcoded values are deliberately **not** corrected, because it cannot be ruled out that a
previous session read the submitted file. Ask Sophie which version these came from, then fix
this table in one edit. Tracked as open item 8 in `../../CLAUDE.md`.

Among participants with VS under **both** sound and oral stimulation, does the VS occupy the
same drawings? The paper reports 12 exact / 5 partial / 3 none; the recount reports 2 / 12 / 6.

"Partial" is defined in the recount as agreement on **at least 50% of the drawings**, matched
against **at least one** oral stimulus. Fifty percent *of what* is not stated, so both
denominators are computed.

```{r concordance-spatial}
sound_sets <- by_stim |> filter(e == 1, any_vs == 1) |> select(pid, sound_set = set_im)

both_pids <- p |> filter(vs_sound, vs_ops_alone) |> pull(pid)
cat("participants with VS under both sound and OPS-alone:", length(both_pids), "\n")

jacc <- by_stim |>
  filter(pid %in% both_pids, e %in% 13:23, any_vs == 1) |>
  inner_join(sound_sets, by = "pid") |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    a = list(strsplit(sound_set, ",")[[1]]),
    b = list(strsplit(set_im, ",")[[1]]),
    inter = length(intersect(a, b)),
    exact = identical(sort(a), sort(b)),
    frac_of_sound = inter / length(a),
    frac_of_union = inter / length(union(a, b))
  ) |>
  ungroup()

classify <- function(df, frac_col) {
  df |>
    group_by(pid) |>
    summarise(
      any_exact = any(exact),
      best      = max(.data[[frac_col]]),
      .groups   = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(cat = case_when(any_exact ~ "exact",
                           best >= 0.5 ~ "partial",
                           TRUE ~ "none"))
}

for (fc in c("frac_of_sound", "frac_of_union")) {
  cat("\n--- overlap as a fraction of", fc, "---\n")
  print(table(classify(jacc, fc)$cat))
}
```

# 4. Concordance of effect between COS and DS

Among those who eliminated the sound-induced VS with **both** COS and DS, do anatomically
equivalent stimuli agree? The paper's mapping (Fig. 2): M1 ~ palatal traction on 1.1/2.1;
M2 ~ buccal pressure on 1.1/2.1/3.1/4.1; M3 ~ lingual traction on 3.1/4.1.

```{r concordance-cosds}
equiv <- list(M1 = c("11P", "21P"),
              M2 = c("11V", "21V", "31V", "41V"),
              M3 = c("31L", "41L"))

both_pids2 <- elim |> filter(by_COS, by_DS) |> pull(pid)
cat("eliminated with both COS and DS:", length(both_pids2), "\n")

# elimination response per oral stimulus, phase 3 (sound maintained)
er <- by_stim |>
  filter(pid %in% both_pids2, e %in% 2:12) |>
  mutate(eliminated = any_vs == 0) |>
  select(pid, oral, eliminated)

pairs <- map_dfr(names(equiv), function(m) {
  er |>
    filter(oral == m) |>
    select(pid, cos_elim = eliminated) |>
    left_join(
      er |> filter(oral %in% equiv[[m]]) |>
        group_by(pid) |>
        summarise(ds_elim = any(eliminated), .groups = "drop"),
      by = "pid"
    ) |>
    mutate(cos = m, match = cos_elim == ds_elim)
})

cosds <- pairs |>
  group_by(pid) |>
  summarise(n_match = sum(match), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(cat = case_when(n_match == n ~ "total",
                         n_match == 0 ~ "none",
                         TRUE ~ "partial"))
print(table(cosds$cat))
```

# 5. Reconciliation table

```{r reconcile}
rebuild <- prev(p$vs_ops_alone)
sp_sound <- table(classify(jacc, "frac_of_sound")$cat)
sp_union <- table(classify(jacc, "frac_of_union")$cat)
cd <- table(cosds$cat)
g <- function(tb, k) if (k %in% names(tb)) as.integer(tb[[k]]) else 0L

rec <- tribble(
  ~number,                              ~manuscript, ~recount, ~rebuild,
  "No VS under any condition",                   4L,       4L, rebuild$neither,
  "Any VS",                                     34L,      34L, rebuild$any_vs,
  "VS with sound (E1)",                         23L,      23L, rebuild$n_sound,
  "VS with OPS",                                31L,      31L, rebuild$n_ops,
  "VS with sound only",                          3L,       3L, rebuild$sound_only,
  "VS with OPS only",                           11L,      11L, rebuild$ops_only,
  "VS with both",                               20L,      20L, rebuild$both,
  "Elimination of sound-induced VS",            18L,      18L, sum(elim$any_elim),
  "  ...with DS only",                           6L,       5L, sum(elim$by_DS & !elim$by_COS),
  "  ...with COS only",                          1L,       2L, sum(elim$by_COS & !elim$by_DS),
  "  ...with both",                             11L,      11L, sum(elim$by_DS & elim$by_COS),
  "Spatial concordance: exact",                 12L,       2L, g(sp_sound, "exact"),
  "Spatial concordance: partial",                5L,      12L, g(sp_sound, "partial"),
  "Spatial concordance: none",                   3L,       6L, g(sp_sound, "none"),
  "COS-DS concordance: total",                   4L,       5L, g(cd, "total"),
  "COS-DS concordance: partial",                 5L,       3L, g(cd, "partial"),
  "COS-DS concordance: none",                    3L,       3L, g(cd, "none")
) |>
  mutate(
    agrees_with = case_when(
      rebuild == manuscript & rebuild == recount ~ "both",
      rebuild == manuscript ~ "manuscript",
      rebuild == recount    ~ "recount",
      TRUE ~ "NEITHER"
    )
  )

print(as.data.frame(rec), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nSpatial concordance under the alternative denominator (union):\n")
print(sp_union)

out <- file.path("..", "outputs", "tables")
dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(rec, file.path(out, "reconciliation.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# 6. Two structural absences

```{r absences}
cat("Phase 1 (no stimuli) columns present in the file:",
    sum(grepl(" E0$", grid_cols)), "\n")
cat("Times the sound-only condition was measured:",
    length(unique(by_stim$e[by_stim$e == 1])), "\n")
```

Neither is a coding problem; both are limits of what was recorded.

- **No baseline column.** The paper's "no participant reported VS in the absence of stimuli"
  is not in this file.
- **The sound-only condition was measured once.** Within-session stability of the outcome is
  therefore not estimable, and the elimination endpoint in section 2 cannot be separated from
  ordinary response instability.

```{r session}
sessionInfo()
```
